title: AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.21482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation. Machine learning algorithms analyze satellite imagery and socioeconomic data to predict poverty and promote sustainable development. AI has also transformed disaster response and conflict monitoring, providing innovative solutions for assessing damage and urgent needs and tracking displacement.

translated_title: AI驱动的灾害响应与流离失所监测
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）已在广泛的人道主义任务中展现出其潜力，为世界上一些最紧迫的挑战提供了可扩展的、数据驱动的解决方案。例如，在应对气候变化方面，AI驱动的模型正被用于实现更快、更准确的全球天气预报、可再生能源的控制与设计，以及森林砍伐的监测。机器学习算法通过分析卫星图像和社会经济数据来预测贫困并促进可持续发展。AI还变革了灾害响应和冲突监测，为评估损失与紧急需求以及追踪流离失所人口提供了创新的解决方案。
tldr: 本文阐述了人工智能在人道主义领域的广泛潜力，尤其是在变革灾害响应、损失与紧急需求评估以及流离失所人口追踪方面的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This paper highlights AI's broad potential in humanitarian tasks, particularly its transformative role in disaster response, damage and urgent needs assessment, and displacement monitoring.
